reviews.title: Very good but expensive
reviews.comment: Great for gaming, the ray tracing is excellent and a noticeable improvement. When the fans kick into high gear it gets pretty noisy and can be distracting, but usually it is very quiet. Overall its merely okay for the money since it is typically selling for more than MSRP.
